description: Kubecost FinOps connector (read-only). Reads Kubernetes cost allocation from the owner's own Kubecost service (`KUBECOST_URL`, default port 9090) through `GET /model/allocation`, one row per namespace (or controller, pod, label) per UTC day, with the CPU, RAM, GPU, persistent-volume, network, load-balancer, shared and external cost of each. One tool: `kubecost_allocation_list`. Kubecost is always self-hosted, so the host is supplied by the gateway at spawn time and the static manifest network list is intentionally empty. An optional `KUBECOST_TOKEN` is sent as a bearer token for an authenticating ingress. No write tool; GET only.
author: Nimbus
